title: Duplicate Chunk IDs
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In `ChunkProcessor`, the chunk manipulation functions such as `pushChunk()` will perform a downcast of Chunk ID and Indexes from `uint256` to `uint32`. This effectively reduces the maximum number of chunks to `type(uint32).max`, As chunks represent the paired/wrapped ERC721, this means that NFT supply based on SFT418 will be similarly capped as well.  The issue is that capping of the NFT supply to 32-bit is not compliant with EIP721, which allows up to `type(uint256).max` NFTs. This is evident from the use of `uint256` to repr
